requires: Gen2 MPC (aarch64), MPC OS 3.10.1 or newer; development prototype, hardware test pending
about: Local development prototype of the Geonkick DSP for MPC. Single percussion instrument, three layers, nine oscillators. MPC-app listening acceptance and CPU benchmark pending. Adapted source is available in the local project; public fork/release is pending. The source_repo URL is reserved for that future fork.
